verdicts.reason: A has no visible 'Reserve a Case' CTA. A dark logo strip is jammed against the right edge with illegible micro-text, and the body copy is squeezed into an unreadable narrow column at the far left. B keeps the dark logo panel, the headline and an orange CTA in a sensible left-to-right banner order. But its body copy and legal text are microscopic, the headline is cramped into three dense lines, and the far-left copy column touches the edge, so it is still clearly broken.
